title: USB & peripheral diagnostics
tips: `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` shows the full USB tree and power draw.
Bus-powered hubs often fail when too many devices draw current.
Devices that disappear after sleep are classic USB selective suspend issues.
Test the same device on another port and another machine before blaming the peripheral.
Thunderbolt docks need the correct firmware and a direct (non-hub) connection.
